address: Chalfont Dene, Chalfont St Peter, Gerrards Cross ,SL9 0LX
bio: Treat yourself to an elegant Afternoon Tea at The Lytton at Chalfont Dene, a beautiful hideaway in the hills of Buckinghamshire, where guests can enjoy delicious savouries, scones and sweet treats for just £22.95.  Located in Chalfont House, the elegant restaurant boasts grand chandeliers, crisp white linen and purple velvet accents for a modern update on the fine-dining experience.  There is a great emphasis on seasonal, local produce at The Lytton - expect a delicious range of finger sandwiches, classic homemade scones and preserves, plus sweet treats and teas.  Soak up the beauty of the Buckinghamshire countryside before leaving for Gerrard's Cross Rail Station, which is just a leisurely drive away.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
